learning_outcomes.text: Understand the main optimization methods used in mechanical design and structural calculation.
Enable suitable method selection for given problems.
Emphasize optimization as a product design aid tool.
Be familiar with classical deterministic methods.
Be familiar with global methods based on stochastic approaches.
Be familiar with recently introduced industrial approaches like structural topology optimization.

syllabus_topics: Formulation of optimization problems: identification of decision variables, criteria/objectives, and relevant constraints.
Multi-objective optimization, Pareto front, and its reformulation into a single-objective problem.

Optimization methods: principles of single and multi-variable optimization, continuous, constrained and unconstrained methods, deterministic and stochastic methods (simulated annealing and genetic algorithms).
Implementation of optimization problems: practical work on Matlab and Excel for a case study.
